_comment: Minimal fallback model manifest baked into the Docker image. Used by bootstrap.sh ONLY when /workspace/models.json does not exist on the volume (i.e. first-time users with no orchestrator pre-staging). For real runs, the orchestrator (e.g. asuka_multi_model_smoke.py in the cloud-ai-image-generation skill) writes the full multi-model manifest onto the network volume BEFORE the pod starts, and this file is ignored.
_hash_legend: sha256 (lowercase hex) is the SERVER-PUBLISHED content hash — sourced from HF tree API (LFS sibling oid) or CivitAI /api/v1/model-versions/{id} (files[].hashes.SHA256). Bootstrap verifies each local file by hashing it and comparing. Verified hashes are cached in /workspace/models-hashes.json, keyed by the manifest sha256 — so a server-side change invalidates the cache automatically.

checkpoints.name: animagine-xl-4.0
checkpoints.note: Single worked example. Public HF repo (no auth strictly required; the bootstrap always sends the Authorization header when auth=huggingface). The sha256 was obtained from https://huggingface.co/api/models/cagliostrolab/animagine-xl-4.0/tree/main (siblings[].lfs.oid). To run a multi-model pipeline, drop a real models.json at /workspace/models.json on the volume and this file will be ignored.

loras.name: illustrious-style-sdxl
loras.note: Placeholder example showing the sha256=null fallback path: when no server hash is known, bootstrap falls back to size match. Set sha256 to a real value (fetched from CivitAI /api/v1/model-versions/{id} -> files[].hashes.SHA256) for the strong check.
